intro.label: Intro
intro.title: Welcome
intro.body:
Welcome! ty-plus creates a personal workspace for faster work.
Place presets/widgets and streamline your workflow. Let's begin setup!

language.label: Language
language.title: Select Language
language.body: Choose your preferred language. The interface will update immediately after selection.

support.label: Location
support.title: Select AE Folder
support.body: Choose your After Effects application folder. On Windows this is the Support Files directory; on macOS it's the app folder containing Presets.

subfolders.label: Folders
subfolders.title: Adjust Sub-folders
subfolders.body: This step appears when you change paths away from defaults. Customize Presets/Scripts/Plug-ins if needed.

presets.label: Presets
presets.title: Select Presets
presets.body:
Pick preset files (.ffx) from your Presets folder to add as initial presets.
You can add/import more later from the + menu. Folder selection will be grouped automatically.

scripts.label: Scripts
scripts.title: Select Scripts
scripts.body:
Pick script files (.jsx, .jsxbin) from your Scripts folder to add as initial presets.
You can also create Script/Expression presets later from Code Preset.

plugins.label: Plug-ins
plugins.title: Select Plug-ins
plugins.body:
Pick effect files (.aex/.plugin) from your Plug-ins folder to add as initial presets.
You can import more later if needed.

workspace.label: Workspace
workspace.title: Workspace Basics
workspace.body:
Drag to move and resize presets and widgets.

- Ctrl/Cmd+drag to move
- Use Layout Lock to prevent edits
- Search dims non-matching items
- Right-click for edit/group actions

adding-presets.label: Presets
adding-presets.title: Adding Presets
adding-presets.body:
Use the + menu to add presets, groups, and widgets.

- Switch side panels for presets list
- Downloaded online presets auto-place

finish.label: Finish
finish.title: Ready to Start!
finish.body:
Press Finish to save your settings.

Let's get started!
